## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem, concrete trigger and resulting behaviour. Link any issue.

## Evidence

Include a minimal recipe, reference or before/after example as appropriate. State units and uncertainty for model changes. Remove personal calendar details.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Relevant IT/EN text, formulas and documentation agree with the change
- [ ] Relevant browser/PDF checks completed, or explain why they do not apply
- [ ] No credentials, generated test outputs or unrelated changes included
